_comment: Whether byoutoyou may operate in a state at all, kept apart from coverage.json (which is about having people there). A market cannot go live in a state whose status is not 'open' — the site keeps it on waitlist regardless of what coverage.json says. Statuses: open = cleared, we may operate; conditions = allowed but something extra is required first; hold = the model itself is at risk here, do not sign anyone; unverified = nobody has checked with that state's board yet, which is where every state starts.

default.note: Nobody has confirmed with this state's cosmetology board that a licensed professional may work at a patient's bedside here, or what that requires. Check before opening a market.

statuses.open: Cleared. Licensed professionals may work at the bedside and contractor status is not unusually exposed.
statuses.conditions: Allowed, but a specific requirement has to be met first.
statuses.hold: Do not open. The employment-classification test in this state puts the whole contractor model at risk.
statuses.unverified: Not yet checked with the state board.

CA.note: California applies the ABC test broadly. Prong B asks whether the work is outside the usual course of the hiring entity's business — bedside beauty visits are precisely byoutoyou's usual course, so a contractor classification is very hard to defend here. Employ through a staffing partner or stay out.

MA.note: Massachusetts applies the same strict 'outside the usual course of business' prong as California.

NJ.note: New Jersey's Department of Labor adopted final ABC-test rules in 2026 codifying how classification is assessed across unemployment, wage and worker-protection law.
sources: N.J.A.C. worker classification rules, adopted 5 May 2026

FL.note: Florida allows cosmetology services outside a licensed salon when the client cannot come to one because of ill health — which covers a hospital patient — but the arrangement must be made through a licensed salon. byoutoyou needs a licensed salon partner (or its own licence) in Florida before taking a booking.

MN.note: Minnesota requires the practitioner to hold a homebound service permit to work outside a licensed salon. Verify each professional's permit before their first visit.

classificationTest.note: Most of the ABC states apply the test only to unemployment insurance, which is survivable; California, Massachusetts and New Jersey apply it broadly, which is not. Treat this as a flag for the attorney conversation, not a verdict.
